author: PokerFace
body:
Hello, I would like to join a team but I'm not sure which ones to join. 
I may not seem like much and many of you may not know me as this is one of my first times on the forum. A few of you however know me and I'm not sure if you are active on the forums to possibly refer me and give me bonus points for a team acception.
Here are my statistics as of July.10

K/D-0.7762
PVP K/D-0.8684-I focus on getting the monuments, not killing people.

My current ranking of all users is 627th
My current ranking of non-upgraded users is 340.
-This is ranking is very close to indigobob and PvP_Epic
If I had a donor rank, I would be near the ranks of 200. (I calculated this by multiplying my total exp which is the small numbers underneath the Overall Xp, and multiplying it by 2.
Some players near this ranking are, MissCarmel, Zieno12345, W4ffUI

I would like to take the positions where my main objective is to destroy the monument.
I'm not sure if Rocky_Cuchita actually remembers me but you can ask him for some background reference of me in game.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Cons: I am using a 4gb ram computer with intel pentimum processor, I lag rarely with minimal settings. If I skype, my mic may be funky sometimes.                                                       Pros: I am very good at sniping and pvp and am often accused of hacking. I have even been accused by people with prestige. <------ I swear it's not a lie. Although I'm not good enough to take Pinkyice in a 1v1 with swords.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 I hope at least someone will find me worthy of joining their team. I will decline all offers if I am presented with a position without a main objective of getting the monument.                             - Thank You In Advance.                                                                                                                      -PokerFace_Legend (I had accidentally archived the previous post)
